blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The verified ThUSD implementation is a plain ERC-20 with permit and burn: transfers, approvals, and balances follow the standard with no hooks, no fees, no pause, and no transfer allowlist, and TheoWhitelist gates only minting and redemption, so no current on-chain path freezes holder transfers. Freeze exposure is possible rather than absent because the token is a UUPS proxy whose owner, the two-day timelock behind Theo's 4-of-6 Safe, can upgrade the implementation to introduce transfer controls after the delay. The Guardian's emergency pause reaches mint, redemption, and sthUSD operations only.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: thUSD is Ethereum-native through a plain ERC-20 with a single minter (ThUSDMinter) administered by the Theo two-day timelock, and reaches Stable and Arbitrum through LayerZero v2 OFTs at shared address 0x9aa9aa0530a6af70ee7bc47cf1240100f514b065, with the Ethereum adapter escrowing 50,106,870.73 thUSD (verified 2026-09-29) against representations minted on those chains. Documented lanes use a 3-required plus 1-of-2-optional DVN set (Deutsche Telekom, Horizen, Canary required; P2P, Nethermind optional) with 15 block confirmations; BSC and Mantle OFTs are deployed at the same address but hold zero supply and have no documented live lane.

routes.reviewNote: Canonical home deployment verified at Ethereum block 26083731: thUSD is an ERC-1967 proxy with verified ThUSD logic 0xcd04f57464d25f257089a286aab47df096d300ad, owner timelock 0x2bb4b7e6e83fa6b77d0143dad631843cb73dca02 (172800-second minimum delay), and a single minter, the ThUSDMinter contract 0x2d99ac801dc0edadd53f5688fef2317932e8696e. Cross-chain movement runs through the separate thUSD adapter 0x9aa9aa0530a6af70ee7bc47cf1240100f514b065, which held 50,106,870.73 thUSD of escrow on 2026-09-29, bit-for-bit the sum of the Stable (49,916,245.78) and Arbitrum (190,624.95) representations, so Ethereum totalSupply conserves the global supply.

LayerZero v2 OFT representation of Ethereum-native thUSD at the documented shared address (endpoint() = 0x6f475642a6e85809b1c36fa62763669b1b48dd5b on Stable, read 2026-09-29). totalSupply() read 49,916,245.786914 thUSD (6 decimals) on 2026-09-29, backed by escrow in the Ethereum adapter. The owner() read returned 0x2bb4b7e6e83fa6b77d0143dad631843cb73dca02, which Theo documents as the chain-local timelock with an 18-hour delay for peers, send library, and rate limits.
